# Atlas Tissue Review 2026-04-15

Review of the full block list with [[benedikt-kraus]] and [[amara-okonkwo]] after batch 1 sequencing and before batch 2 sectioning.

## Findings

- Batch 1 (12 pairs): all 24 sections passed QC; one biopsy needed a second section after a fold.
- In the remaining 28 pairs, three pre-treatment biopsies had DV200 below 30% on the first test. Two recovered above 30% on deeper levels; one did not.
- Two resection blocks were dominated by necrosis and had little viable tissue to compare.

## Decisions

- Replace the failed biopsy pair with the reserve metastasis on the list (same patient criteria, 2022 resection), keeping the atlas at 40 pairs.
- For the two necrotic resections, use alternative blocks from the same lesion chosen by Benedikt for maximum viable tumour.
- Update [[atlas-tissue-manifest]] and log both changes with reasons.
- Add a pre-sectioning H&E check for viable content to [[tissue-section-qc]].
